stem:
A person has $1.20 in pennies. The person makes 4 equal stacks of pennies. The equation 1.20 \div 4 = 0.30 shows the value of each stack in dollars.

Which hundredths model best represents this situation?

options.label: A
options.text: Four horizontal rectangles stacked, each with 30 shaded squares and 70 unshaded squares on a 100-square grid.

options.label: B
options.text: Four vertical rounded rectangles, each covering 30 shaded squares on a 100-square grid, followed by an empty 100-square grid.

options.label: C
options.text: Three horizontal rectangles stacked, each with 30 shaded squares and 70 unshaded squares on a 100-square grid.

options.label: D
options.text: Three vertical rounded rectangles, each covering 30 shaded squares on a 100-square grid, followed by an empty 100-square grid.

visual_elements: Four horizontal rectangles stacked with 30 shaded squares each (A)
Four vertical rounded rectangles with 30 shaded squares each next to one empty grid (B)
Three horizontal rectangles stacked with 30 shaded squares each (C)
Three vertical rounded rectangles with 30 shaded squares each next to one empty grid (D)
